# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (ATR contraction), price tends to revert to the intraday VWAP as liquidity returns, providing a mean‑reversion edge. This setup captures that reversion by entering long on bullish candles that close near VWAP when ATR is compressed relative to its recent average.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When ATR(14) < 0.5 × ATR(14) 20‑period average **AND** price closes within 0.1% of VWAP (|Close‑VWAP|/VWAP < 0.001) on a bullish candle (close > open) **AND** the candle's body is > 50% of its total range, then go long at the next bar open.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the entry candle; target at 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, trail stop to break‑even; allow runner to trail 15% off highest high using a chandelier exit based on ATR(14).  
**Regime filter:** Only consider entries when VIX < 15 and time is between 10:00‑12:00 EST; skip when VIX > 25 or during known news spikes.
